summary: Ericsson filed a 6-K announcing weekly share buybacks executed August 24-28, 2026, repurchasing 2,150,000 Class B shares at a weighted average price of SEK 96.77, totaling SEK 208.05 million. The buybacks are part of a SEK 15 billion program announced April 16, 2026, running through March 31, 2027, conducted via Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE on Nasdaq Stockholm. Treasury stock now totals 102,818,676 Class B shares. The Board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares at the 2027 AGM. Watch for continued weekly execution pace and any program adjustments.
